text: {"memo": "Oracle Corp (ORCL) delivered solid top‑line growth in FY2024, with revenue rising to $52.96\u202fbillion from $49.95\u202fbillion in FY2023—a roughly 6\u202fpercent increase. Net income accelerated sharply to $10.47\u202fbillion, up from $8.50\u202fbillion a year earlier, representing a 23\u202fpercent jump and a net margin of about 20\u202fpercent. Operating income improved to $15.35\u202fbillion from $13.09\u202fbillion, a 17\u202fpercent rise and an operating margin near 29\u202fpercent. Diluted EPS climbed to $3.71 from $3.07, a 21\u202fpercent gain. Operating cash flow also expanded to $18.67\u202fbillion from $17.16\u202fbillion, a 9\u202fpercent increase and a cash‑flow margin of roughly 35\u202fpercent. The company’s strong cash generation and improving profitability margins underscore its disciplined execution. Overall, ORCL shows consistent growth and robust cash conversion, supporting a buy rating."}
